scope: Math Sciences source asset and its dedicated audit only; no master, manifest, shared index, or other building was edited.
metadata_changes: Added the 2018 Indiana 3DEP raster method, height percentiles, and limitations to the Math asset and its three modeled roof objects.
Recorded that current roof geometry is retained pending architectural elevations; the raster-to-model height discrepancy is not assigned to any particular story or component.

tile_metadata.query_source: Indiana Statewide 3DEP Lidar Dates MapServer, layer 5, point query at 40.4261348,-86.915642

roof_and_height.method: Rasterize the Purdue GIS FID 227 footprint in the tile CRS, resample the same-tile bare-earth DTM to the DSM grid, then summarize DSM-minus-DTM. The vertical values have no embedded unit tags; US survey feet are corroborated by the local DTM median ~624.04 matching Purdue GIS Elevation=623.3 (GIS attribute unit undocumented).

model_comparison.interpretation: The median observed surface exceeds the modeled roof-slab top by ~3.5 m and the 95th-percentile surface is ~3.9 m above the penthouse coping top. This reveals a real model/data discrepancy but does not identify which story or roof component should move; no geometry was changed. The 5-ft grid includes possible roof equipment and returns and cannot resolve the thin modeled antennas.

upper_surface_zone.interpretation: A raised roof-surface region is visible in the raster. The local mapping is approximate and the feature is not proven to be a penthouse; these bounds must not be used as surveyed footprint dimensions.

roof_and_height.accuracy_context: Indiana's 2016-2020 QL2 source describes statewide RMSEz ≤0.10 m and an expected 95th-percentile NVA ≤0.196 m, but instructs users to assess their own AOI. This audit performs no local survey-point validation and the raster products have undocumented vertical datum tags.
unverified: Exact wall-roof transition height and per-floor elevations.
Penthouse plan outline, parapet dimensions, roof-panel layout, and equipment identity.
Communications mast and antenna height; a 5-ft DSM does not reliably resolve thin vertical elements.

exterior_source_inventory.archive_photo_record: Purdue eArchives item 823 / PPBUC00750, undated B&W exterior photograph, direction unknown.
exterior_source_inventory.archive_drawing_record: Purdue eArchives item 824, undated B&W exterior-view drawing, direction unknown; its drawing content could not be visually inspected in this run.
exterior_source_inventory.result: No trustworthy direction-tagged elevation/photo is available for filling the blank north/west surfaces. No openings or wall details were invented.

interior_source_inventory.current_public_evidence: 2022 third-floor Board plan and 2025 Purdue Libraries reopening article/photo support a library zone, core relationships, and broad furniture/material types; they do not establish an as-built room/furniture schedule.
interior_source_inventory.access_limit: Purdue's Building Deputy manual says construction plans are available by facilities request and floor plans through Purdue's FM:S access; it says these plans should not be copied or redistributed. No current as-built plan was accessed. Existing partitions, route widths, stair layout, and furniture placement remain schematic.

rating_status: No R10 self-score claimed. The independent R9 score of 7.8/10 remains in force pending a fresh reviewer.
